content: Win32 RegisterHotKey posts WM_HOTKEY to a message loop; EnumDisplayMonitors/GetMonitorInfo expose the virtual desktop and monitor rectangles; PerMonitorV2 DPI awareness plus WM_DPICHANGED/coordinate conversion is required for mixed-DPI displays. macOS Core Graphics CGEventTapCreate can observe system events but requires Accessibility/assistive-device permission for key events; NSScreen.frame/backingScaleFactor and conversion APIs define global/backing coordinates; ScreenCaptureKit is the current high-performance screenshot/capture API and requires Screen Recording permission. Full-screen overlays need AppKit collection behavior and must be tested per app/Space.
